candidates.name: Existing UAR filesystem skill reconciliation and typed selection errors
candidates.fit_for_gap: G1: align startup registration with durable selection requirements and expose redacted cause categories

maintenance.source: current checkout; served-artifact equivalence not established

evidence.claim: Initialization loads provider results without persistence; reconciliation searches fs-skills and agent-skills IDs.
Loaded entries remain memory-only; matching snapshot refuses registered IDs absent from durable skills.

risks: Retained boot counts strongly support but do not prove the exact later StorageMissing branch.
Persisting skill bodies can overwrite API-owned/configured metadata unless source precedence and scoped selection are retained.
Do not bypass reconciliation globally or silently disable skills.
candidates.decision_rationale: Adapt current startup/selection mechanisms rather than add a discovery library. Readiness R1/R2 needs source alignment and precise diagnostics; runtime code is required, exact served-build root cause remains conditional.

candidates.name: Pinned SurrealDB response errors plus UAR fenced CAS and same-attempt settlement reconciliation
candidates.fit_for_gap: G2: classify query/result failures and reconcile an original terminal attempt without model/tool replay

maintenance.registry_health: Not queried; no dependency change proposed

evidence.claim: Context7 exposes check/take_errors; local pinned query.rs independently confirms these APIs. Main-branch examples are not a version-equivalence claim.
Pinned response supports statement error inspection before result extraction.
Existing UAR retries only typed rolled-back transaction conflicts, bounded; transport/unknown outcomes are returned.
Existing CAS pattern rereads exact predicate and preserves inconclusive errors.
Upstream issue distinguishes statement-query error handling from commit error flattening; it does not diagnose this run.
Upstream issue discusses typed conflict identification; text matching is not an adequate basis for automatic replay.

risks: Recorded take(0) error could be statement failure or decoding; it does not prove rollback or commit.
Existing boolean CAS and Storage(error.to_string()) erase useful distinctions.
A duplicate no-usage settlement can increment usage_revision; convergence needs a stable same-outcome receipt/no-op decision.
Do not reuse ingestion retry timing/cap without an explicit phase bound; do not release unknown reservations.
candidates.decision_rationale: Reuse pinned SDK and existing UAR patterns; no upgrade or new storage service. R3 requires typed outcome distinction, fenced receipt comparison and bounded settlement-only reconciliation, hence runtime code. Diagnostic evidence must select exact failure branch.

candidates.name: Existing Tokio member lanes, bounded task execution and output-artifact dependency graph
candidates.fit_for_gap: G3: preserve team concurrency design and prove actual overlapping specialists plus dependent merge

evidence.claim: Lane key includes member ID; distinct members use distinct mutex lanes and worker tasks under shared active permits.
Selected attributed output artifacts are handed to task context.
Existing BDD observes live runs and requires both completed artifact IDs in final writer context.

risks: Permitted concurrency is not observed successful overlap.
Fast completion can make sequential snapshots miss a short real overlap.
A new executor/event bus would expand scope without fixing the identified admission gap.
candidates.decision_rationale: Retain the implemented executor, not a new framework. R4 needs no replacement runtime architecture; real-path acceptance still depends on admission/settlement fixes and exact authorization.

build_required.need: Align actual filesystem provider reconciliation with durable skill selection, retain ownership/source precedence and safely categorized failure evidence.
build_required.why_no_candidate: Current application source must enforce its own provider IDs, stored-skill invariants and precedence; a new discovery package cannot supply that policy.

build_required.need: Define and implement stable same-attempt terminal settlement receipts and safe reconciliation for confirmed/ambiguous CAS results.
build_required.why_no_candidate: Pinned SDK APIs reveal errors, but application attempt fences, effect/accounting certainty and duplicate receipts are UAR-specific.

build_required.need: Bind repaired-source artifact to the existing math/writing BDD and capture real overlap/merged output without re-running unrelated accepted behaviors.
build_required.why_no_candidate: No library can replace the required actual product evidence; keep the portable script and improve only demonstrated evidence gaps.
